'''Clone Marshal Commander''', or simply '''Marshal Commander''', was the highest [[Military rank/Legends|military rank]] that a [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]] could hold within the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]]. As elite [[Officer/Legends|officers]], Clone Marshal Commanders were entrusted with leading [[Corps/Legends|corps-level]] formations of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], the largest military formation that could be led by a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]], and liaised directly with their assigned [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the Grand Army of the Republic had eighty Clone Marshal Commanders, each overseeing one of the [[Army/Legends|army's]] eighty corps.<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

Within the [[Order of Battle/Legends|hierarchical structure]] of the Grand Army of the Republic, Marshal Commanders were subordinate to [[Senior Jedi General]]s, while [[Senior clone commander|Senior Clone Commanders]] were subordinate to Clone Marshal Commanders.<ref name="TEGtW" /> Notable Clone Marshal Commanders included Marshal Commander [[Bacara/Legends|Bacara]] of the [[Galactic Marines/Legends|21st Nova Corps]],<ref name="Bacara">{{ForceCollection|Clone Commander Bacara|star=4}}</ref> Marshal Commander [[Bly/Legends|Bly]] of the [[327th Star Corps/Legends|327th Star Corps]],<ref name="GGAR" /> Marshal Commander [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] of the [[7th Sky Corps/Legends|7th Sky Corps]],<ref name="Cody">{{SideshowCite|set=Militaries of Star Wars|packtype=Sixth Scale Figure|pack=Republic Clone Trooper (212th Attack Battalion Utapau)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/SSC16clone212.asp}}</ref> and Marshal Commander [[Neyo/Legends|Neyo]] of the [[91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps/Legends|91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps]].<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The rank of Clone Marshal Commander was first mentioned in "[[Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic]]," an eight-page reference article written by [[Karen Traviss]] and [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]] for the [[Star Wars Insider 84|84th issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'',<ref name="GGAR" /> published by [[IDG Entertainment]] on [[September 26]], [[2005]].<ref name="InsiderDate">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20050913.html|text=The Ultimate Clone Guide in ''Star Wars Insider'' #84}}</ref>
